units.source_text: 桐壶院有个妃子，人称为丽景殿女御的，并未生男育女，

en.t: Emperor Kiritsubo had a consort known as the Lady of Reikeiden, but she had borne neither sons nor daughters,

units.source_text: 自从桐壶院驾崩之后，境况日渐冷落，

en.t: and after Emperor Kiritsubo passed away, her circumstances grew lonelier and more neglected day by day,

units.source_text: 全赖源氏大将照拂，孤苦度日。

en.t: so she lived in solitude and hardship, depending entirely on the care of Genji, now a general.

units.source_text: 她的三妹花散里，曾经在宫中与源氏公子有露水因缘。

en.t: Her third younger sister, Hanachirusato, had once shared a brief love affair with Prince Genji at court.

units.source_text: 源氏公子对女人一向多情，一度会面，永不相忘，

en.t: Prince Genji had always been tenderhearted toward women, and once he had met someone, he never forgot her,
yet he did not show her any special favor either.

units.source_text: 这便使得那女的情思焦灼，梦想为劳。

en.t: This left the woman tormented by longing, troubled even in her dreams.

units.source_text: 近来源氏公子对世间万事都感忧恼，

en.t: Recently Prince Genji had been feeling distressed by everything in the world,

units.source_text: 便想起了这个孤寂的情人，再也忍耐不住。

en.t: and he thought of this lonely lover until he could no longer restrain himself.

units.source_text: 五月的梅雨时节，有一天难得放晴，

en.t: During the rainy season in the fifth month, one day the sky cleared in a rare break of fine weather,

units.source_text: 他便悄悄地去访问这花散里了。

en.t: so he quietly went to visit Hanachirusato.
